Theorem
[Parallel $\mathrm{spin}^c$ spinors (Theorem 35.12)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0306 1. ch35:35.12\group Linear Stability

If a compact Einstein manifold with nonpositive scalar curvature admits a nonzero parallel $\mathrm{spin}^c$ spinor, then \[ Ah_{ij}=\Delta _Lh_{ij}+R_i{}^kh_{kj}+R_j{}^kh_{ik} \] has nonpositive spectrum. In particular this holds for compact Kähler--Einstein manifolds with nonpositive scalar curvature.

An algebraic soliton on a homogeneous space is a left-invariant metric satisfying \[ \Rc =\lambda I+D, \] with $D$ a derivation. Such expanding solitons include all nilsolitons and many solvsolitons; nilsolitons of dimensions at most six and several solvsoliton families are strictly linearly stable.
